# DockAction

`Flare.Components.IDE.DockAction`

The kind of change proposed by the workspace.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Activate` | `0` | Select an item in its group. |
| `Close` | `1` | Remove the item from the layout. |
| `Move` | `2` | Move the item within its group or into another group. |
| `Split` | `3` | Create a new group beside a group and move an item into it. |
| `Resize` | `4` | Change the fraction of space assigned to the first branch. |

## Used by components

- `FlareDockWorkspace`
